subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, STARTED is written as ATSRDET, and CLOSURE is written as OLCSERU. How will CONFIRM be written in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

STARTED is written as ATSRDET.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e2a91f39b4f928103e101d2d04c4867e6612e0f4e8f4569ffbfa1d86c2b9836.png] 

And

CLOSURE is written as OLCSERU.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d2f848aee6035a3491f932295024a907612d7c4161952b0bb0583aebe6ed554.png] 

Similarly,

CONFIRM will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7662b65336c3b3c1a715267dd3e2484420da11d1a7b5ff5bed549f7899823a5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "NOCFMRI".**
